    Latest GST Changes

    57th GST Council meeting · 8 October 2026. Recommendations require the relevant law amendments, notifications or circulars. Effective dates have not been verified here; check the applicable instrument before acting.

    Swipe to read the updates
    GST
    Policy

    Process reforms, with targeted rate measures

    The meeting focused on compliance reforms, alongside specific rate measures and clarifications.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Legal

    Removal of arrest powers proposed

    Section 69 omission was recommended; this is not itself an enacted repeal.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Legal

    Prosecution threshold: ₹5 crore

    The proposed threshold rises from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Penalties

    Lower general penalty proposed

    The maximum general penalty would fall from ₹25,000 to ₹10,000.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Refunds

    Acknowledgement within 10 days

    The proposed period falls from 15 days, with deemed acknowledgement where applicable.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Refunds

    90% provisional refund proposed

    Risk-based automatic sanction is proposed for zero-rated and inverted-duty refund claims.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Refunds

    Automatic cash-ledger refunds

    Excess electronic cash-ledger balances would be refunded through system-based sanction.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    ITC

    Broader credit eligibility proposed

    Selected blocked-credit restrictions would be eased, including specified insurance and catering expenses.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Registration

    Rule 14A: existing automatic route

    Already operating for eligible applicants intending to pass ITC up to ₹2.5 lakh monthly.

    8 October 2026 · Existing measure
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Registration

    Clearer registration documents

    Prescribed documents, FAQs and portal guidance would simplify applications.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Registration

    Revised GST REG-01

    Document-selection lists would make application requirements clearer.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Registration

    Automatic amendments proposed

    Principal-place changes remain an exception; Rule 14A registrations receive broader automatic acceptance.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Small businesses

    ARQP: approved in principle

    Optional annual returns and quarterly payments were proposed for B2C-only taxpayers up to ₹5 crore.

    8 October 2026 · In-principle proposal
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Compliance

    Conditional late-fee relief

    Eligible taxpayers up to ₹5 crore could avoid late fees by filing within the due month.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Returns

    Better return reconciliation

    GSTR-1/1A/IFF enhancements would improve alignment with GSTR-3B.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Goods movement

    Intelligence-led interception

    Interception would require specific intelligence and authorisation at Joint Commissioner level or above.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Goods movement

    Limits on transit-state checks

    Restrictions are proposed, with exceptions for missing e-way bills or origin/destination documents.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    E-commerce

    Simplified seller registration

    Proposed Rule 14B would assist qualifying sellers using marketplace warehouses outside their home state.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Notices

    ₹10,000 notice threshold

    No show-cause notice would issue below the proposed combined-tax threshold.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Exports

    Export-service eligibility changes

    Proposed changes would ease specified foreign-branch service transactions and clarify export treatment.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗
    GST
    Exports

    More automated export refunds

    A later phase proposes risk-based full zero-rated refunds after verification and dues adjustment.

    8 October 2026 · Council recommendation
    Official government PDF ↗

    Source: GST Council, Government of India. Read the official GST Council release (Government PDF) ↗
